items.title: StubHub Targets Weather, Lineup Changes, Long Lines with FestProtect
items.why: Event-ticket protection could be a card benefit idea; review StubHub's terms and whether the cover is offered for card-bought tickets.
items.summary_ai: StubHub is launching FestProtect, a festival ticket product covering weather, lineup changes and long entry lines.
items.take: Event-ticket protection could be a card benefit idea; review StubHub's terms and whether the cover is offered for card-bought tickets.
